hero.title: We are YETI Dresden
hero.subtitle: Young Entrepreneurs in Tech and Innovation

sections.title: Our Mission
sections.richText: We empower young people to become entrepreneurial role models through networking, training and resources.

sections.title: What is YETI?
sections.richText: **Y**oung **E**ntrepreneurs, in **T**ech and **I**nnovation Dresden is an educational initiative which aims to support the participants in becoming entrepreneurial role models and influential figures for society. The 18-month program enables students to develop business ideas and leadership skills. The scholarship holders are mentored by the start-up community and dresden|exists.

bullets.title: 3 semesters
bullets.text: Educational program over three semesters, followed by Alumni network.

bullets.title: 10–15 hours/week
bullets.text: Commitment of approximately 10–15 hours per week.

bullets.title: Thursday is YETI-Day
bullets.text: All input sessions are held on Thursdays.

bullets.title: Language
bullets.text: Program conducted in English; international friendly.
